facts: --autoConnect is documented for local Chrome 144 or newer and requires remote debugging to be enabled in Chrome.
--browser-url attaches to a running debuggable Chrome instance.
The selected Chrome channel is stable by default.
The configuration reference documents --isolated and profile options.

facts: autoConnect uses Chrome's default profile for the selected channel and asks the user to approve the connection.
Manual attach uses --browser-url with a matching remote-debugging port and non-default user-data directory.
The project describes autoConnect for local browser sharing and manual attach for sandbox or forwarded routes.
officialFactsChecked.sourceType: Official Chrome DevTools MCP advanced-usage guide

facts: Troubleshooting directs readers to check logs and the Node/npm environment used by the MCP client.
autoConnect failures can involve Chrome version, running state, remote-debugging toggle, user approval, another debugger connection, or macOS profile-folder permissions.
VM-to-host access may need forwarding or an SSH tunnel; test hostname and port reachability from the MCP environment.
officialFactsChecked.sourceType: Official Chrome DevTools MCP troubleshooting guide

facts: Chrome 136 and newer require a non-default user-data directory for command-line remote debugging.
Current Playwright MCP documentation separates Chrome/Edge channel connection, HTTP CDP endpoint, Playwright server endpoint, and browser-extension connection.
Chrome/Edge channels use values such as --cdp-endpoint=chrome or --cdp-endpoint=msedge and the in-browser remote-debugging permission; they do not require a manually selected port.
HTTP CDP endpoint configuration uses the browser's reachable endpoint.
The extension attaches to existing tabs; by default it selects the last-used profile with the extension installed, or --profile-dir-name can select a profile.

A restricted frame URL such as chrome:// or chrome-extension:// can make Chrome detach the Playwright extension debugger; the README suggests disabling the injecting extension on that site, changing Site access to On click, or using another profile.
Configuration distinguishes a browser CDP endpoint from a remote Playwright server endpoint and browser profile options.
